name: Hatsukoi Yohou.
source:
This is the first game by I.D. The pure white snow descends on the street, turning it into a beautiful snowscape. It’s like it is a pure heart that hasn’t been sullied. However, that purity quickly disappears once touched. Koutarou lives alone and he often wonders how lovers pass this cold season. Do they become closer to one another and spend the holidays by themselves? It would a lie to say for him to say that he doesn’t feel lonely at times. Then this winter, he fell in love for the first time. A first love he cannot forget.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/05/18/may-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
本作是I.D.的处女作。纯白的雪落在街道上，将四周化作美丽的雪景，宛如一颗尚未受到玷污的纯洁心灵。然而，这份纯洁一经触碰便会迅速消逝。孝太郎独自生活，时常思考恋人们会如何度过这个寒冷的季节。他们会变得更加亲密，独自共度假日吗？若说他从未感到寂寞，那便是在撒谎。就在这个冬天，他第一次坠入爱河。这是一场令他永生难忘的初恋。

[摘自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/05/18/may-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
